title: Drone Delivery Dash
description: Pilot a delivery quadrotor across eight rooftop routes, matching packages to pads while managing wind, hazards, landings, and battery.

prompt.objective: Build a rooftop delivery game with stabilized drone flight, hazards, and precise landings.

mintAssets.brief: A modular quadrotor and miniature city kit with pads, cranes, pylons, trees, and blimps.
Rotor hum, wind, package, collision, warning, delivery, and score cues.

experience: Pilot a stabilized quadrotor with keyboard, gamepad, or dual-stick touch controls.
Match packages to rooftop pads across eight routes with rising wind, hazards, and landing precision.
prompt.visualDirection: Bright toy city, strong delivery colors, readable rooftops, and clean telemetry.

thumbnail.alt: The Drone Delivery Dash title over a colorful miniature city of apartment rooftops and trees.

social.title: Drone Delivery Dash
social.description: Fly eight rooftop routes through wind and hazards before the battery runs out.
